items.label: Google DNS
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Setting Google DNS' -ForegroundColor Green
netsh interface ip set dns name="Ethernet" static 8.8.8.8 | Out-Null
netsh interface ip add dns name="Ethernet" 8.8.4.4 index=2 | Out-Null

netsh interface ip add dns name="Ethernet" 1.0.0.1 index=2 | Out-Null

items.label: Balanced
High Performance
Ultimate Performance
Set Services to Manual
items.desc: Starts services only when they are needed.

items.label: Disable Windows Transparency
items.desc: Disables transparency, may improve system performance.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Transparency' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize" /v "EnableTransparency" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

items.label: Disable HAGS
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling HAGS' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers" /v "HwSchMode" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

items.label: Set IPv4 as Preferred
items.desc: Prefers IPv4 over IPv6, can improve latency.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Setting IPv4 Priority' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters" /v "DisabledComponents" /t REG_DWORD /d 32 /f

items.label: Disable Mouse Delay
items.desc: Disables the 400ms menu show and hover delay.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Mouse Delay Times' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v "MenuShowDelay" /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f
reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse" /v "MouseHoverTime" /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f

items.label: Limit Defender CPU Usage
items.desc: Limits Defender maximum CPU usage at 25%.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Limiting Windows Defender Usage' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scan" /v "AvgCPULoadFactor" /t REG_DWORD /d "25" /f
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scan" /v "ScanAvgCPULoadFactor" /t REG_DWORD /d "25" /f

items.label: Disable Core Isolation
items.desc: May improve performance at the cost of security.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Core Isolation' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" /v "Enabled" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

items.label: Disable SysMain
items.desc: Disables prefetch, might improve performance at the cost of app startup time.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Prefetch' -ForegroundColor Green
Stop-Service -Name "sysmain"
Set-Service -Name "sysmain" -StartupType Disabled

items.label: Disable Storage Sense
items.desc: Disables Storage Sense, stops automatic disk cleanup.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Storage Sense' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy" /v "01" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

items.label: Disable Search
items.desc: Disables Windows Search, disables drive indexing.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Windows Search' -ForegroundColor Green
Stop-Service -Name "wsearch"
Set-Service -Name "wsearch" -StartupType Disabled

items.label: Disable Fast Startup
items.desc: Disables Fast Startup, may fix boot and update issues.
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Fast Startup' -ForegroundColor Green
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power" /v "HiberbootEnabled" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

items.label: Disable Hibernation
items.ps1:
Write-Host '-- Disabling Hibernation' -ForegroundColor Green
powercfg /h off
